claims.text: 管理层在 2025 Q4 电话会给出 2026 年全年 CapEx 指引区间为 1,750 亿至 1,850 亿美元；Sundar Pichai 表述为“anticipated to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion”。

citations.quote: our 2026 CapEx investments are anticipated to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion
For the full year 2026, we expect CapEx to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion

claims.text: CFO Anat Ashkenazi 说明单位为美元、适用期间为 2026 全年，并称投资将在年内逐步增加（ramping over the course of the year）。

citations.quote: For the full year 2026, we expect CapEx to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion, with investments ramping over the course of the year.

claims.text: 管理层就 CapEx 数字给出限定：供应可得性、组件定价与现金支付时点可能造成报告 CapEx 数字一定波动。

citations.quote: Keep in mind that the availability of supply, pricing of components, and timing of cash payments can cause some variability in the reported CapEx number.

claims.text: CFO 说明 CapEx 投向包括支持 Google DeepMind 前沿模型开发的 AI 算力、改善 Google Services 用户体验与广告 ROI、显著 Cloud 客户需求，以及 Other Bets 的战略投资。

citations.quote: We're investing in AI compute capacity to support frontier model development by Google DeepMind, ongoing efforts to improve the user experience, and drive higher advertiser ROI in Google Services, significant Cloud customer demand, as well as strategic investments in Other Bets.

claims.text: Q&A 中 CFO 说明资产构成：2025 年投资约 60% 用于机器（服务器），40% 为长期资产（数据中心和网络设备）；2026 年“fairly similar”。

citations.quote: Approximately 60% of our investment in 2025, and it's going to be fairly similar in 2026, went towards machines; so, the servers. And then 40% is what you would refer to as long duration assets, which is our data centers and networking equipment.

claims.text: CFO 说明 2026 年“just over half”的 ML compute 预计投向 Cloud 业务，这是对 ML compute 分配的表述，而非对全公司 CapEx 的分配表述。

citations.quote: Another important component is how we allocate this CapEx, and we've commented in the past about the allocation of our ML compute across the business. And for 2026, just over half of our ML compute is expected to go towards the Cloud business.

claims.text: 60%/40% 的资产构成与 ML compute 分配是两个不同口径：前者按机器与长期资产划分，后者仅针对 ML compute；材料未给出 Cloud 占全公司 CapEx 的比例，因此不能据此推断 Cloud 占全公司 CapEx 超过一半。

citations.quote: Approximately 60% of our investment in 2025, and it's going to be fairly similar in 2026, went towards machines; so, the servers. And then 40% is what you would refer to as long duration assets, which is our data centers and networking equipment.
And for 2026, just over half of our ML compute is expected to go towards the Cloud business.

limitations: 材料为 2025 Q4 电话会，不含 2026 Q2 电话会记录；source_policy 明确“no Q2 call exists in inputs”，因此本材料无法回答管理层在 2026 Q2 电话会的解释。
材料未提供 2026 年 CapEx 指引从 2025 Q4 到 2026 Q2 的变化或更新，也未提供任何 2026 Q2 期间或 Q2 单季度的 CapEx 指引。
材料未给出 Cloud 占全公司 CapEx 的比例定义或数值，也未说明 ML compute 分配与全公司 CapEx 之间的换算关系；因此不能从“just over half of our ML compute”推断 Cloud 占全公司 CapEx 超过一半。
材料未披露“machines/servers”与“ML compute”的口径对应关系，也未说明 60%/40% 是否与 ML compute 分配同一分母。
材料未披露 60%/40% 与“just over half of ML compute”是否可加总或交叉用于推算 Cloud CapEx 金额；缺少相应定义与金额数据。
findings: 不能从 Cloud 在 ML compute 中的份额推断 Cloud 在全公司 CapEx 中的份额。
2026 CapEx 指引仅适用于 2026 全年（full year 2026），不是单季度或 YTD 口径；且带供应、定价与现金支付时点限定。
stop_reason: 已依据 2025 Q4 电话会材料回答 2026 年 CapEx 指引、单位、期间、限定及 60%/40% 与 ML compute 分配；并指出材料不含 2026 Q2 电话会，故无法回答该季度解释。
